name: Pinterest Marketing Strategist
description: Produce composed Pinterest pins from your real documents and approved image library. Reads your Google Drive folder for brand context, scans your image library for visual assets, matches images to generated copy, and outputs pins ready to review and post. Tracks performance and learns from every batch — better images, better copy, better boards, every cycle.
longDescription:
Ships **3 skills**, **3 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (3): `client-context` (Reads the client's Google Drive folder and image library to build structured Pinterest context), `performance-learning` (Tracks pin performance, extracts specific learnings about image-copy pairings, and feeds them back into future batches), `pin-strategist` (Pinterest content creation methodology)
- **Commands** (3): `create` (Produce composed Pinterest pins — copy, matched image, board, keywords, posting schedule — ready to review and post), `setup` (Configure your brand, boards, image library, and Pinterest goals), `track` (Log pin performance, extract learnings, and feed them back into future batches)
- **MCP servers** (1): `google-drive`

Installs with `claude plugin install pinterest-marketing-strategist@claude-community` from `EditorialOS/pinterest-marketing-strategist`.
